entities.name: Tomás Andrés Mauro Muldoon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomás Andrés Mauro Muldoon, OFM was an American Roman Catholic prelate, who served in Honduras. He was bishop of Juticalpa from 1983 to 2012. He died in Framingham, Massachusetts, on 14 June 2024, at the age of 85.
